title: Settings
network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Cellular service and Bluetooth proximity
network.cellularFooter: Turning off cellular service gates connections to external services and sets signal level to 0 bars. Local apps (Notes, Camera, Photos, Calculator) operate offline.
network.cellularDescription: Gate network access and external services
network.bluetoothFooter: When Bluetooth is ON, nearby devices can discover your device for proximity features. Turning Bluetooth OFF renders your device invisible to proximity scans and blocks unsolicited contact sharing.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Banners, alerts, sounds, and icon badges
notifications.dndFooter: Notifications still arrive and wait in the shade — they just don't interrupt. Calls still ring on screen so you can answer them, and a favourite or a second call within a few minutes rings out loud.
notifications.dndDescription: Silence banners and sounds without going offline
notifications.showBannerDescription: Display popup banners when notifications arrive
notifications.soundsDescription: Play alert sound on incoming notification
notifications.iconBadgesDescription: Show unread count badges on launcher icons
notifications.perAppFooter: Each switch is combined with the master switches above — an app can be quieter than the device, never louder.
notifications.otherResourcesFooter: Notifications sent by other resources on this server, grouped by the resource that sent them.
apps.title: Apps
apps.subtitle: Storage and uninstall, per app
apps.systemNote: Ships with the device and cannot be uninstalled.
apps.addOnsNote: Installed from the Store, and removable from here or there.
appInfo.author: Author
appInfo.notificationsFooter: Combined with the master switches in Settings > Notifications — this app can be quieter than the device, never louder.
appInfo.nothingToClear: Nothing to clear — this app has stored nothing yet.
appInfo.clearHint: Returns the app to a freshly installed state. The app stays installed.
appInfo.coreNote: System apps ship with the device and cannot be uninstalled.
appInfo.uninstallHint: Removes the app and everything it stored. It can be installed again from the Store.
appInfo.clearMessage: Everything {name} has stored on this device is deleted and the app returns to a freshly installed state. The app itself stays installed.
appInfo.uninstallMessage: {name} is removed from the device along with everything it stored. You can install it again from the Store.
display.title: Display
display.subtitle: Theme, wallpaper, size and clock
display.sizeFooter: The device always keeps its shape; this changes how large it is drawn on screen.
display.sizeLimited: This window sets how large the device can go. Make it taller for more range.
display.gridFooter: Shrinking the grid moves anything it no longer fits to the next open space, rather than hiding it.
display.motionFooter: Reduced motion turns off the device's animations. Swipes and drags still work — only the animation goes.
theme.colorHint: The wallpaper and every color on the device are generated from this one.
theme.noPhotosDescription: Photos taken with the Camera app can be used as a wallpaper, and the device takes its colors from them.
theme.noPhotosHosted: Photos stored on the image host cannot be used as a wallpaper. Take a photo without one, or pick a color instead.
theme.photoFailed: That photo could not be loaded. Try another.
sound.title: Sound
sound.subtitle: Volume, mute, and button step size
sound.ringtoneHint: Tap a tone to choose it and hear it. A preview plays on silent — you asked for it.
sound.notificationToneHint: Tap a tone to choose it and hear it. Notifications use this chime; calls use the ringtone above.
sound.muteMusicDescription: Silence music without stopping it, yours and anyone nearby
sound.stepHint: How much each press of the volume buttons on the side of the phone changes the volume.
language.title: Language
language.subtitle: The language the device speaks
language.automaticHint: Follows the server's default, then your own language ({locale})
language.footer: Apps translate themselves; one that has no translation for a language shows English.
lockscreen.title: Lock Screen & Passcode
lockscreen.subtitle: Passcode and when the device asks for it
lockscreen.passcodeHint: {min}–{max} digits. Entered twice, so a typo does not lock you out of your own device.
lockscreen.removeConfirm: Remove your passcode? The lock screen will stop appearing until you set a new one.
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Keyboard shortcuts on the device
shortcuts.footer: {label} is bound in FiveM's own Key Bindings menu.
about.title: About
about.subtitle: Number, build, and first boot
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.streamerModeDescription: Blur every picture until you tap it
privacy.streamerModeFooter: Attachments, gallery photos and listing pictures stay blurred until tapped, and blur again when you leave the app.
license.title: License
license.copyFailed: Could not copy the source address
devtools.title: Developer Tools
devtools.subtitle: Battery, signal, and event simulation
devtools.adminRequired: Developer Tools require the mica.admin permission
devtools.hiddenToast: Developer Tools hidden — tap OS Version 10x to restore
devtools.toggleDescription: Turn off to hide — 10 taps on OS Version restores
devtools.batteryError: Could not set the battery level
devtools.callTestBrowser: Fakes the toast — nothing real to ask here.
devtools.callTestGame: Rings you for real. Caller Name only shows if the number matches a saved contact.
devtools.callError: Could not simulate an incoming call
devtools.simulatedToastMessage: This is a test push notification from Developer Tools.
devtools.testSmsMessage: Hey! This is a test SMS from Developer Tools.
devtools.testMailContent: Please review your upcoming schedule and metrics.
frame.footer: Only how the phone looks; apps are laid out the same in every frame.
frame.label: Camera style
yourData.title: Your data
yourData.subtitle: See what micaOS holds, or erase it
yourData.exportFooter: Everything micaOS stores for this character, grouped by category. Copy it to keep a record.
yourData.loadFailed: Your data could not be loaded.
yourData.empty: micaOS holds nothing for this character.
yourData.warnIrreversible: This is irreversible. Everything micaOS holds for this character is erased and cannot be recovered.
yourData.warnReports: Content under an open report is kept until the report is resolved.
yourData.failed: Your data may not have been deleted. Reload your data to check, then try again if anything is left.
yourData.partial: Your data was only partly deleted.
yourData.failedCategories: Could not be deleted: {categories}. Try again later.
yourData.truncatedRows: Cut short: showing the first {shown} rows
yourData.truncatedSize: Cut short to fit the size limit: showing {shown} rows
yourData.exportCut: Some categories were cut short. What is shown is a sample; deleting removes everything, not just this view.
yourData.warnModeration: Moderation records are kept when you delete your own data: the audit log, reports still pending review, unpaid invoices and import records. Deleting the character removes those too.
yourData.reloadHint: Your data was deleted, so the list above is out of date. Reload to see what is left.
yourData.timedOut: The request timed out, but it may still be finishing on the server. Wait a moment, then reload your data to check.
